caption: The pipeline bumps versionCode 7→8 and versionName 1.2.3→1.2.4, builds and shrinks the APK, signs it with the release keystore, then tests the signed APK before deploying. Notice signing comes before testing: the bytes tested are the bytes shipped.

spec.title: Release APK pipeline
spec.aria: The release pipeline bumps versionCode from 7 to 8 and versionName from 1.2.3 to 1.2.4, builds and shrinks the APK, signs it with the release keystore, tests the signed APK, then deploys it to a store or by direct install.
